title: Fractions, Units and Necessary Conditions
overview: Compare and add fractions only when the parts come from the same whole. Read the denominator as the unit and the numerator as the count, build equivalent fractions with the same positive integer, and add 1/2 and 1/3 as sixths. Each stated condition stays visible; page attribution is unchecked.
scopeNote: Covers same-whole fractions, denominator as unit, equivalence by the same positive integer, and adding 1/2 and 1/3 as sixths.

lessons.title: Counting Equal Parts and Building Sixths
lessons.objective: State that fractions describe selected equal parts of the same whole, name the denominator as the unit and the numerator as the count, apply the positive-integer equivalence rule, and add 1/2 and 1/3 of the same whole as 3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6.
lessons.focus: Compare quantities only when the fractions refer to the same whole. Name the denominator as the unit and the numerator as the count. Use the rule that multiplying both numerator and denominator by the same positive integer changes the partition without changing the quantity, then add 1/2 and 1/3 with sixths: 3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6. Open points: the chunk does not restrict denominators, and the page attribution is unchecked.
